lessons.name: Months and Seasons
lessons.description: The calendar: months, seasons and the adjectives made from them.

multiple_choice.name: Match the months
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each month to its Bulgarian name.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Summer begins
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Лятото започва на 21 __ по календара.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Лятото започва на 21 юни по календара." means "Summer begins on 21 June by the calendar."

true_false.name: True or false: Esen
true_false.sentence: "Есен" is autumn.
true_false.explanation: Correct. The four seasons are пролет, лято, есен and зима.

fill_in_the_blank.name: In autumn
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: През __ листата падат.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "През есента листата падат." means "In autumn the leaves fall." After през the season takes the article.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Winter months
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Декември, януари и февруари са __ месеци.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Декември, януари и февруари са зимни месеци." means "December, January and February are winter months."

true_false.name: True or false: Yuli
true_false.sentence: "Юли" is the month of June.
true_false.explanation: "Юли" is July. June is "юни".

multiple_choice.name: Match the season adjectives
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English adjective to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Four seasons
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: В годината има четири __ и дванадесет месеца.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "В годината има четири сезона и дванадесет месеца." means "A year has four seasons and twelve months." After a number, сезон becomes сезона.

true_false.name: True or false: Small letters
true_false.sentence: Bulgarian month names are written with a small letter: "май", not "Май".
true_false.explanation: Correct. Months and days of the week start with a small letter.

fill_in_the_blank.name: We go to the seaside
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: През __ ходим на море.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "През август ходим на море." means "In August we go to the seaside."

lessons.name: Weather Through the Year
lessons.description: Rain, snow and sunshine, and sentences with no "it".

multiple_choice.name: Match the weather nouns
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Snow in winter
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: През зимата често __ сняг.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "През зимата често вали сняг." means "In winter it often snows." Rain and snow both "fall": вали.

true_false.name: True or false: Slantseto gree
true_false.sentence: "Слънцето грее" means "The sun is shining".
true_false.explanation: Correct. Грея means "to shine" or "to warm".

fill_in_the_blank.name: A strong wind
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Днес __ силен вятър.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Днес духа силен вятър." means "There is a strong wind today." The wind "blows": духа.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Hot and dry
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: През лятото е __ и сухо.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "През лятото е горещо и сухо." means "In summer it is hot and dry."

true_false.name: True or false: Oblachno
true_false.sentence: "Облачно" means "sunny".
true_false.explanation: "Облачно" means "cloudy". Sunny is "слънчево".

multiple_choice.name: Match the weather adjectives
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Sunny tomorrow
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Утре ще бъде __ и топло.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Утре ще бъде слънчево и топло." means "Tomorrow it will be sunny and warm." Weather adjectives take the neuter -о.

true_false.name: True or false: No it
true_false.sentence: Weather sentences like "Студено е" have no word for "it".
true_false.explanation: Correct. "Студено е" is simply "(It) is cold".

fill_in_the_blank.name: How many degrees
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Колко __ е навън?
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Колко градуса е навън?" means "How many degrees is it outside?"

lessons.name: Winter Holidays
lessons.description: Christmas, New Year and winter fun.

multiple_choice.name: Match the winter holiday words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Many presents
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Дядо Коледа носи много __ на децата.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Дядо Коледа носи много подаръци на децата." means "Father Christmas brings the children lots of presents."

true_false.name: True or false: Christmas Day
true_false.sentence: Christmas Day in Bulgaria is on 25 December.
true_false.explanation: Correct. Christmas Eve, Бъдни вечер, is on 24 December.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Welcoming the New Year
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: На 31 декември посрещаме __ година с приятели.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "На 31 декември посрещаме Новата година с приятели." means "On 31 December we see in the New Year with friends."

fill_in_the_blank.name: A snowman in the yard
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Децата правят снежен __ в двора.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Децата правят снежен човек в двора." means "The children are making a snowman in the yard."

true_false.name: True or false: Badni vecher dinner
true_false.sentence: The traditional Christmas Eve (Бъдни вечер) dinner is made with meat.
true_false.explanation: The Christmas Eve dinner is meatless: beans, stuffed peppers, sarmi and pumpkin pastry.

multiple_choice.name: Match more winter words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Songs for health
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Коледарите пеят __ за здраве.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Коледарите пеят песни за здраве." means "The carol singers sing songs for good health."

true_false.name: True or false: Koledari
true_false.sentence: "Коледари" are young men who sing from house to house at Christmas.
true_false.explanation: Correct. They wish each household health and a good harvest.

fill_in_the_blank.name: A new sledge
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Имаме нова __ за снега.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Имаме нова шейна за снега." means "We have a new sledge for the snow."

lessons.name: Bulgarian Cities
lessons.description: The capital, the big cities and what each is known for.

multiple_choice.name: Match the city words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: The capital of Bulgaria
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: София е __ на България.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "София е столицата на България." means "Sofia is the capital of Bulgaria."

true_false.name: True or false: Plovdiv
true_false.sentence: Plovdiv is the second largest city in Bulgaria.
true_false.explanation: Correct. Plovdiv is also one of the oldest cities in Europe.

fill_in_the_blank.name: On the Black Sea
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Варна е на брега на __ море.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Варна е на брега на Черно море." means "Varna is on the Black Sea coast."

fill_in_the_blank.name: A small village
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Живея в малко __ близо до Русе.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Живея в малко село близо до Русе." means "I live in a small village near Ruse." Малко is neuter, like село.

true_false.name: True or false: Ruse
true_false.sentence: Ruse is on the Black Sea coast.
true_false.explanation: Ruse is in the north, on the Danube.

multiple_choice.name: Match the cities
pairs: City of the ancient Roman theatre
Old capital with the Tsarevets fortress
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each description to the Bulgarian city.

fill_in_the_blank.name: The city of humour
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Габрово е градът на __ и сатирата.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Габрово е градът на хумора и сатирата." means "Gabrovo is the city of humour and satire." After на the short article -а is used.

true_false.name: True or false: Veliko Tarnovo
true_false.sentence: Veliko Tarnovo was a capital of Bulgaria in the Middle Ages.
true_false.explanation: Correct. It was the capital of the Second Bulgarian Empire.

fill_in_the_blank.name: An ancient theatre
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: В Пловдив има древен __ от римско време.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "В Пловдив има древен театър от римско време." means "In Plovdiv there is an ancient theatre from Roman times."

lessons.name: Mountains, Rivers and the Sea
lessons.description: The geography of Bulgaria and the four points of the compass.

multiple_choice.name: Match the landscape
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: The highest mountain
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Рила е най-високата __ в България.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Рила е най-високата планина в България." means "Rila is the highest mountain range in Bulgaria."

true_false.name: True or false: Danube border
true_false.sentence: The Danube forms much of Bulgaria's northern border.
true_false.explanation: Correct. Across the river is Romania.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Through the middle
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Стара планина минава през __ на страната.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Стара планина минава през средата на страната." means "The Balkan range runs through the middle of the country."

fill_in_the_blank.name: Seven lakes
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: В Рила има седем __ едно над друго.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "В Рила има седем езера едно над друго." means "In Rila there are seven lakes, one above the other." The plural of езеро is езера.

true_false.name: True or false: No coast
true_false.sentence: Bulgaria has no coastline.
true_false.explanation: Bulgaria has a long coast on the Black Sea, in the east.

multiple_choice.name: Match the compass points
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Greece is to the south
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Гърция е на __ от България.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Гърция е на юг от България." means "Greece is to the south of Bulgaria."

true_false.name: True or false: Iztok
true_false.sentence: "Изток" means "east".
true_false.explanation: Correct. The sun rises in the east: "Слънцето изгрява от изток".

fill_in_the_blank.name: The longest river
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Дунав е втората най-дълга __ в Европа.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Дунав е втората най-дълга река в Европа." means "The Danube is the second longest river in Europe." Only the Volga is longer.

lessons.name: Farm Animals
lessons.description: Animals in the village yard and the sounds they make.

multiple_choice.name: Match the animals
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each animal to its Bulgarian word.

fill_in_the_blank.name: The dog barks
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Кучето __ в двора.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Кучето лае в двора." means "The dog is barking in the yard."

true_false.name: True or false: Krava
true_false.sentence: "Крава" is a cow.
true_false.explanation: Correct. Milk from a cow is "краве мляко".

fill_in_the_blank.name: Two goats
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Баба има две __ и една крава.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Баба има две кози и една крава." means "Grandma has two goats and a cow."

fill_in_the_blank.name: The cat drinks milk
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Котката __ мляко.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Котката пие мляко." means "The cat drinks milk."

true_false.name: True or false: Kon
true_false.sentence: "Кон" means "cow".
true_false.explanation: "Кон" means "horse". A cow is "крава".

multiple_choice.name: Match the farmyard
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each animal to its Bulgarian word.

fill_in_the_blank.name: The rooster crows
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Петелът __ рано сутрин.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Петелът пее рано сутрин." means "The rooster crows early in the morning." In Bulgarian the rooster "sings".

true_false.name: True or false: Kucheta
true_false.sentence: The plural of "куче" (dog) is "кучета".
true_false.explanation: Correct. Many neuter nouns ending in -е take -ета: куче, кучета; момче, момчета.

fill_in_the_blank.name: One egg a day
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Кокошката снася по едно __ на ден.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Кокошката снася по едно яйце на ден." means "The hen lays one egg a day."

lessons.name: Wild Animals
lessons.description: Animals of the Bulgarian forests and mountains.

multiple_choice.name: Match the small wild animals
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each animal to its Bulgarian word.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Bears in the forests
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Мечките живеят високо в __ на Рила.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Мечките живеят високо в горите на Рила." means "Bears live high up in the forests of Rila."

true_false.name: True or false: Taralezh
true_false.sentence: "Таралеж" is a hedgehog.
true_false.explanation: Correct. You can often see one in a Bulgarian garden at night.

fill_in_the_blank.name: A clever animal
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Лисицата е много __ животно.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Лисицата е много хитро животно." means "The fox is a very cunning animal." Животно is neuter.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Hares like carrots
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Зайците обичат да ядат __ и зеле.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Зайците обичат да ядат моркови и зеле." means "Hares like to eat carrots and cabbage."

true_false.name: True or false: Valk
true_false.sentence: "Вълк" means "bear".
true_false.explanation: "Вълк" means "wolf". A bear is "мечка".

multiple_choice.name: Match the big wild animals
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each animal to its Bulgarian word.

fill_in_the_blank.name: The eagle flies high
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Орелът __ високо в небето.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Орелът лети високо в небето." means "The eagle flies high in the sky."

true_false.name: True or false: Bears in Bulgaria
true_false.sentence: Brown bears live in the Bulgarian mountains.
true_false.explanation: Correct. They live in Rila, Pirin, the Rhodopes and the Balkan range.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Squirrels in the trees
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: В парка има много __ по дърветата.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "В парка има много катерици по дърветата." means "There are lots of squirrels in the trees in the park."

lessons.name: At the Seaside
lessons.description: A day on the beach by the Black Sea.

multiple_choice.name: Match the beach words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Lying on the beach
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Цял ден лежим на __ и четем.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Цял ден лежим на плажа и четем." means "We lie on the beach and read all day."

true_false.name: True or false: Valna
true_false.sentence: "Вълна" can mean a sea wave or wool.
true_false.explanation: Correct. "Вълните са високи" is about the sea, and "пуловер от вълна" is a wool jumper.

fill_in_the_blank.name: A castle of sand
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Децата правят замък от __ на брега.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Децата правят замък от пясък на брега." means "The children are making a sandcastle on the shore."

fill_in_the_blank.name: Let's swim
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Водата е топла, хайде да __ в морето.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Водата е топла, хайде да плуваме в морето." means "The water is warm, let's swim in the sea."

true_false.name: True or false: Pyasak
true_false.sentence: "Пясък" means "shell".
true_false.explanation: "Пясък" means "sand". A shell is "мида".

multiple_choice.name: Match the beach things
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Your swimsuit
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Не забравяй __ си за плажа!
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Не забравяй банския си за плажа!" means "Don't forget your swimsuit for the beach!"

true_false.name: True or false: Sozopol and Nesebar
true_false.sentence: Sozopol and Nesebar are towns on the Bulgarian Black Sea coast.
true_false.explanation: Correct. Both have old towns full of wooden houses and churches.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Put on sunglasses
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Слънцето е силно, сложи си __ очила.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Слънцето е силно, сложи си слънчеви очила." means "The sun is strong, put on your sunglasses." Очила is plural.

lessons.name: A Day in the Mountains
lessons.description: Hiking, mountain huts and the peaks of Bulgaria.

multiple_choice.name: Match the hiking words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Sleeping in the hut
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Спим в __ под върха.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Спим в хижата под върха." means "We sleep in the hut below the peak."

true_false.name: True or false: Hizha
true_false.sentence: A "хижа" is a mountain hut where hikers can sleep.
true_false.explanation: Correct. Bulgarian mountains have a whole network of huts.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Up Musala peak
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Качваме се на __ Мусала.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Качваме се на връх Мусала." means "We are climbing Musala peak." Before a name the noun takes no article.

fill_in_the_blank.name: In your backpack
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Сложи водата в __ си и да тръгваме.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Сложи водата в раницата си и да тръгваме." means "Put the water in your backpack and let's go."

true_false.name: True or false: Pateka
true_false.sentence: "Пътека" means a road for cars.
true_false.explanation: A пътека is a path or a trail. A road for cars is a "път".

multiple_choice.name: Match the mountain words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: A steep path
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Пътеката е много __ и тясна.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Пътеката е много стръмна и тясна." means "The path is very steep and narrow." Пътека is feminine.

true_false.name: True or false: Vitosha
true_false.sentence: Vitosha is the mountain right next to Sofia.
true_false.explanation: Correct. You can reach it from the city by bus or on foot.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Cold at the top
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Горе на върха е __ и духа вятър.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Горе на върха е студено и духа вятър." means "Up on the peak it is cold and windy."

lessons.name: Spring Customs
lessons.description: Martenitsi, Easter and the spring holidays.

multiple_choice.name: Match the spring words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Martenitsi for health
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: На първи март си подаряваме __ за здраве.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "На първи март си подаряваме мартеници за здраве." means "On 1 March we give each other martenitsi for good health."

true_false.name: True or false: Red and white
true_false.sentence: A martenitsa is made of red and white thread.
true_false.explanation: Correct. White stands for purity and red for health and life.

fill_in_the_blank.name: When you see a stork
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Свалям мартеницата, когато видя __ или цъфнало дърво.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Свалям мартеницата, когато видя щъркел или цъфнало дърво." means "I take off my martenitsa when I see a stork or a tree in blossom."

fill_in_the_blank.name: Easter bread
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: За Великден ядем __ и шарени яйца.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "За Великден ядем козунак и шарени яйца." means "At Easter we eat sweet Easter bread and painted eggs."

true_false.name: True or false: Kozunak
true_false.sentence: "Козунак" is a Christmas drink.
true_false.explanation: A козунак is a sweet, plaited bread baked for Easter.

multiple_choice.name: Match the spring holidays
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English name to the Bulgarian holiday.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Flowers on Women's Day
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: На Осми март подаряваме __ на жените.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "На Осми март подаряваме цветя на жените." means "On 8 March we give flowers to women."

true_false.name: True or false: Gergyovden date
true_false.sentence: Гергьовден (St George's Day) is on 6 May.
true_false.explanation: Correct. It is also the day of the Bulgarian army.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Trees in blossom
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: През пролетта __ цъфтят в бяло и розово.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "През пролетта дърветата цъфтят в бяло и розово." means "In spring the trees blossom in white and pink."
